description: Erection of a two storey side and part single storey rear extension and rear and side roof extensions to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan - received 14th January 2022, Photographs - received 4th April 2022, 1581.A2.PL01 Rev. A, 1581.A2.PL02 Rev. B, 1581.A2.PL03 Rev. C - received 28th April 2022.)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The first floor and roof level side windows, hereby approved, shall be fitted with obscured glazing and shall be non-opening to a height of 1.7m above the floor level of the rooms in which they are installed. The windows shall be maintained as such in perpetuity.

Reason: In order to safeguard the privacy of neighbouring and future occupiers of the site.
